newHostChecks: Git HEAD comparison reads the committed file and never changes the confirmed baseline
resetting the baseline to Git HEAD or an empty document is applied and can be undone
initialBaseline = gitHead starts a new review from the last commit
files created after monitoring started are shown as added and unreviewed
renaming a file carries its baseline and keeps unreviewed changes
the reviewed baseline opens in VS Code's diff editor
the change summary lists unreviewed hunks as Markdown diffs
next-change navigation works in the text editor
missing link targets and anchors are reported as diagnostics
Markdown Lens opens as a custom editor via Open With
saving an edit writes exactly the edited Markdown
fixesFoundDuringValidation: Cursor exits with code 0 when the test runner throws; the runner now requires results/host.json from every editor.
A file deleted between the existence check and the read (seen over Remote - SSH) showed a raw ENOENT; it now shows the missing-file message.
Refreshing the pending list during a scan returned before the scan finished; it now waits for it.
Host checks that inject draft and view messages detach the mounted webview so its own messages cannot race them.

notVerifiable.remoteWorkspaces: WSL, Dev Containers and VS Code for the Web are not covered; Remote - SSH is covered above.
notVerifiable.otherScreenReaders: NVDA and JAWS (Windows) are not covered; VoiceOver is covered above.
notVerifiable.cursorUiScreens: A fresh Cursor profile stops at a mandatory sign-in screen, so the real UI suite needs a signed-in Cursor; Cursor's extension host is covered above.
